metadata.citation: Fujifilm, NEOPAN 100 ACROS II (135), AF3-0258E (20.02-BX), pp2-3; Microfine 20 C small-tank 10-minute table and p3 characteristic/spectral plots.
metadata.datasource: https://asset.fujifilm.com/www/us/files/2020-08/73080443d0289b1a7b116add14a9bdfc/films_neopan100acros2_135_01_0.pdf; PDF SHA256 afb5e24db0d9b7a219b6682b640237a525b7927e8cf1b95ba2299c0be6385cdd; source SHA256 abab0f69291ac74e8113e19a3d2d0b804db5aae7df5d05b5a689902ccac87023. NEOPAN 100 ACROS II 135; Microfine stock, small tank, 20 C, 10 minutes; diffuse visual density. Exposure origin -0.371314014476 log10(lux seconds). Rebuild scripts/prepare_acros100ii.py; see docs/acros100ii.md. The page contains 300 dpi raster plots, not vector centerlines; graph-line width and raster sampling limit precision. The 10-minute curve is identified by its printed label and vertical order; 5/15/20-minute curves are not the selected process. The spectral curve is a wedge spectrogram relative log response; the sheet does not state its density threshold. The profile stores an explicit unspecified-threshold limitation. The x-axis labels are printed at -3 through 1; the plot frame extends left to about -4 and right to about 1; only the plotted curve domain is used. No measured base spectrum, silver grain calibration, halation PSF, or scanner response is supplied by this publication. Microfine 10 minutes is a published starting point, not a guarantee for a particular tank/agitation or aged film. The manufacturer sheet does not state the density threshold for the relative spectral curve. The numeric log_sensitivity_density_over_min field is 0.0 because the schema has no null sentinel; the runtime does not consume it. It is not a measured D-min+1.0 threshold. The 10-minute curve is selected from a 300 dpi raster plot; graph line width and axis reading limit precision. Spectral tails outside 401-663 nm are endpoint-slope assumptions, not measured cutoffs. One aggregate silver record is used; this is not a measured emulsion sublayer decomposition. Exposure zero is the estimated base density plus 1.0; D55 RGB midgray mapping is not absolute ISO or output-brightness calibration. No measured base spectrum, silver grain, halation PSF or scanner response is supplied by the publication. The antihalation metadata tag is a conservative weak default; the sheet does not publish a halation PSF. The preset grain is an approximation based on RMS 7 at 48 micrometers and D-min+1.0; it is not a per-channel grain calibration. Real-lab scans are used for qualitative review only and cannot identify a scanner-independent material response. The characteristic curve clamps outside the plotted range; no inferred shoulder or extra latitude.
